aiTitle: Fix failing cart total test after a refactor

message.content: I extracted the discount logic into its own helper and now one cart test fails. Can you find why and fix it?

content.text: Let me run the cart suite first to see the exact failure before touching anything.

content.content:
FAIL  src/cart.test.js
  cart total
    ✕ applies a 10% member discount (7 ms)

    expected: 90
    received: 100

      18 |   const t = cartTotal(items, { member: true });
    > 19 |   expect(t).toBe(90);
         |             ^

Tests: 1 failed, 11 passed, 12 total

content.text: Clear signal: the member discount is no longer applied, so the total stays at the full 100 instead of 90. That points straight at the refactor — `cartTotal` probably stopped calling the extracted helper. Let me confirm.
Confirmed. The extraction created `applyDiscount`, but `cartTotal` returns the raw `sum` and never calls it. The fix is to route the sum through the helper before returning.

content.content: The file src/cart.js has been updated.

content.text: Re-running the suite to make sure it's green:

content.content:
PASS  src/cart.test.js
  cart total
    ✓ applies a 10% member discount (3 ms)

Tests: 12 passed, 12 total

content.text: Green. `cartTotal` now passes the sum through `applyDiscount`, so a member cart of 100 correctly returns **90**. The refactor is complete and behavior-preserving.
